quote.text: Never say about anything, “I have lost it,” but instead, “I have given it back.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Embrace the thought that as you let your children grow, you aren’t losing them but rather giving them back to life—nurtured to flourish on their own.
  • Parenthood: Recognize that every moment of release, where you allow your child’s independence, is a conscious return of trust, enriching both your lives with maturity and freedom.
  • Leadership: Understand that relinquishing control is not a setback but a deliberate act of empowering others; by “giving back” authority, you foster a culture of accountability and innovation.
  • Leadership: View setbacks or transitions not as losses but as opportunities to hand over responsibilities strategically, ensuring that each team member is inspired to contribute their best.
  • Product Management: In managing products, learn to see each phase—as a product evolves—as a thoughtful return, where outdated features are gracefully set aside to make room for new innovations.
  • Product Management: Adopt this mindset to transform challenges into strategic pivots, recognizing that every phase of product life is a cycle of giving back what no longer serves to spur growth and creative renewal.
